answer: One concrete defense is to hunt for correlation instead of counting heads. Genuine agents each follow their own distinct voyage, reacting to unpredictable prompts in idiosyncratic ways. A sybil fleet run by one operator instead moves in suspicious velvet lockstep, its answers gliding together too smoothly. By sampling surprise challenges and mapping responses onto an interaction trellis, the protocol flags tightly correlated clusters and strips their weight, so a thousand synchronized puppets count as one.
